title: Idealista Agency Scraper
description: Collect Idealista agency profiles with commercial names, website, contact details, listing totals, languages, and media. Batch agency short names and choose a supported market.

batch.title: Agency short names
batch.description: Idealista agency short names from agency microsite URLs.
batch.valueDescription: Idealista microsite short name used for this agency lookup.

schema.description: Agency short name, for example clikalia.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Find Idealista agency profiles with contacts, listing totals, services, languages, and media. Batch agency names to compare companies by market.
storeCopy.intro: Look up Idealista agencies by microsite short name and collect company details, contact information, service defaults, listing totals, languages, and media. Choose the market for each profile.
useCases: Real estate teams can compare agency coverage, listing totals, and service focus.
Market researchers can map agency profiles and languages across supported countries.
Property investors can identify agencies linked to saved listing records.
howToUse: Add an Idealista microsite short name to `agencies` for each lookup.
Choose Spain, Italy, Portugal, or France as the market.
Set `maxResults` and export one agency profile per short name.

faqs.question: What is an agency short name?
faqs.answer: It is the microsite identifier used in an Idealista agency profile URL. Use the short name, not the full URL.

fields.name: success
fields.description: True when the Idealista request returned a successful response.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Idealista response payload for this agency profile, including `shortName`, `activeSinceYear`, `commercialName`, `agencyWebUrl` and related source fields.

fields.name: meta
fields.description: Response metadata from Idealista, such as request duration and endpoint family.

fields.name: agency_name
fields.description: Public name of the Idealista real estate agency.

fields.name: agency_website
fields.description: Agency website URL listed in the Idealista profile.

fields.name: active_since_year
fields.description: Year the agency began operating on Idealista.

fields.name: listing_count
fields.description: Number of listing records reported for this agency profile.

fields.name: agency_short_name
fields.description: Short agency identifier used in the Idealista profile URL.

fields.name: input_microsite_short_name
fields.description: Microsite short name submitted to retrieve this agency profile.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this dataset record was collected.
